```{r setup, include=FALSE}
############################################################
# CCD DESIGN EVALUATION
# Families: FCCD, RCCD, SCCD
# Dimensions: k = 3,...,10
#
# Criteria:
#   D-optimality
#   A-optimality
#   G-optimality
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(FrF2)

dir.create("data_generated", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

set.seed(6)

############################################################
# CCD GENERATOR
############################################################

make_ccd <- function(k, family, nc, rf, ra){

  alpha <- switch(as.character(family),
                  "FCCD" = 1,
                  "RCCD" = (2^k)^(1/4),
                  "SCCD" = sqrt(k))

  if(k <= 6){
    fac <- as.data.frame(FrF2(nruns = 2^k, nfactors = k))
  } else {
    fac <- as.data.frame(FrF2(nruns = 32, nfactors = k))
  }

  fac <- fac[,1:k]
  colnames(fac) <- paste0("x",1:k)

  fac <- mutate_all(fac, ~ifelse(.==1,1,-1))
  fac_rep <- fac[rep(seq_len(nrow(fac)), rf),]

  ax <- matrix(0,2*k,k)

  for(j in 1:k){
    ax[2*j-1,j] <- alpha
    ax[2*j,j]   <- -alpha
  }

  ax <- as.data.frame(ax)
  colnames(ax) <- paste0("x",1:k)

  ax_rep <- ax[rep(seq_len(nrow(ax)), ra),]

  cen <- as.data.frame(matrix(0,nc,k))
  colnames(cen) <- paste0("x",1:k)

  design_points <- bind_rows(fac_rep, ax_rep, cen)

  DesignID <- paste0(family,"_k",k,"_nc",nc,"_rf",rf,"_ra",ra)

  meta <- tibble(
    DesignID = DesignID,
    k = k,
    family = family,
    nc = nc,
    rf = rf,
    ra = ra,
    alpha = alpha,
    N = nrow(design_points)
  )

  list(points = design_points, meta = meta)
}

############################################################
# BUILD QUADRATIC MODEL MATRIX
############################################################

build_X_quadratic <- function(df){

  vars <- names(df)

  form <- as.formula(
    paste0("~ ",
           paste(vars,collapse="+"),
           " + ",
           paste0("I(",vars,"^2)",collapse="+"),
           " + (",
           paste(vars,collapse="+"),
           ")^2")
  )

  model.matrix(form,data=df)
}

############################################################
# COMPUTE D, A, G CRITERIA
############################################################

compute_ADG <- function(design_points, g_n = 5000){

  X <- build_X_quadratic(design_points)

  p <- ncol(X)
  M <- crossprod(X)

  if(qr(M)$rank < p) return(NULL)

  Minv <- solve(M)

  Dcritical <- det(M)^(1/p)

  Acritical <- sum(diag(Minv))

  k <- ncol(design_points)

  Z <- matrix(runif(g_n*k,-1,1),ncol=k)
  colnames(Z) <- colnames(design_points)
  Z <- as.data.frame(Z)

  FZ <- build_X_quadratic(Z)

  Gcritical <- max(rowSums((FZ %*% Minv) * FZ))

  list(
    Dcritical = Dcritical,
    Acritical = Acritical,
    Gcritical = Gcritical
  )
}

############################################################
# PARAMETER GRID
############################################################

k_grid   <- 3:10
families <- c("FCCD","RCCD","SCCD")
nc_grid  <- c(1,3,5,7,10)
rf_grid  <- c(1,2,3)
ra_grid  <- c(1,2,3)

grid <- expand.grid(
  k = k_grid,
  family = families,
  nc = nc_grid,
  rf = rf_grid,
  ra = ra_grid,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

############################################################
# GENERATE DESIGNS
############################################################

meta_list <- vector("list", nrow(grid))

for(i in seq_len(nrow(grid))){

  row <- grid[i,]

  out <- make_ccd(row$k,row$family,row$nc,row$rf,row$ra)

  meta_list[[i]] <- out$meta

  saveRDS(
    out$points,
    file.path("data_generated",
              paste0("design_",out$meta$DesignID,".rds"))
  )
}

design_metadata <- bind_rows(meta_list)

write_csv(design_metadata,
          "data_generated/design_metadata.csv")

############################################################
# COMPUTE RAW CRITERIA
############################################################

meta <- read_csv("data_generated/design_metadata.csv")

out_list <- vector("list", nrow(meta))

for(i in seq_len(nrow(meta))){

  id <- meta$DesignID[i]

  pts <- readRDS(file.path("data_generated",
                           paste0("design_",id,".rds")))

  crit <- compute_ADG(pts)

  if(is.null(crit)) next

  out_list[[i]] <- tibble(
    DesignID = id,
    Dcritical = crit$Dcritical,
    Acritical = crit$Acritical,
    Gcritical = crit$Gcritical
  )
}

mycriteria_raw <- bind_rows(out_list)

write_csv(mycriteria_raw,
          "data_generated/mycriteria_raw.csv")

############################################################
# CONVERT TO EFFICIENCIES
############################################################

df <- meta %>% inner_join(mycriteria_raw, by="DesignID")

mycriteria_eff <- df %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  mutate(
    Defficiency = Dcritical / max(Dcritical),
    Aefficiency = min(Acritical) / Acritical,
    Gefficiency = min(Gcritical) / Gcritical
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(mycriteria_eff,
          "data_generated/mycriteria_eff.csv")

############################################################
# MEAN EFFICIENCY BY k AND FAMILY
############################################################

tab_mean <- mycriteria_eff %>%
  group_by(k,family) %>%
  summarise(
    meanD = mean(Defficiency,na.rm=TRUE),
    meanA = mean(Aefficiency,na.rm=TRUE),
    meanG = mean(Gefficiency,na.rm=TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(Gefficiency)),
    .groups="drop"
  )

write_csv(tab_mean,
          "Tables/mean_eff_by_k_family.csv")

############################################################
# PLOTS
############################################################

plot_eff <- function(dat,ycol,ylab,outfile){

  p <- ggplot(dat,
              aes(x=k,
                  y=.data[[ycol]],
                  color=family,
                  linetype=family,
                  shape=family,
                  group=family))+
    geom_line(linewidth=1.1)+
    geom_point(size=3)+
    labs(
      x="Number of factors (k)",
      y=ylab,
      color="CCD family"
    )+
    theme_minimal(base_size=14)

  ggsave(outfile,p,width=8,height=5)

  p
}

############################################################
# G-EFFICIENCY
############################################################

pG <- plot_eff(tab_mean,
               "meanG",
               "Mean G-efficiency",
               "Figures/mean_Geff_vs_k.png")

############################################################
# D-EFFICIENCY
############################################################

pD <- plot_eff(tab_mean,
               "meanD",
               "Mean D-efficiency",
               "Figures/mean_Deff_vs_k.png")

############################################################
# A-EFFICIENCY
############################################################

pA <- plot_eff(tab_mean,
               "meanA",
               "Mean A-efficiency",
               "Figures/mean_Aeff_vs_k.png")

pG
pD
pA
```

```{r}
############################################################
# REGULARISED + SCALED REGULARISED CCD ANALYSIS
# k = 3,...,10
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

set.seed(6)
lambda <- 0.01
G_N <- 5000

############################################################
# REGULARISED ADG
############################################################

compute_ADG_reg <- function(design_points, lambda = 0.01, g_n = 5000){

X <- build_X_quadratic(design_points)

p <- ncol(X)

M <- crossprod(X)

Mlam <- M + lambda * diag(p)

Minv <- solve(Mlam)

Dcrit <- det(Mlam)^(1/p)

Acrit <- sum(diag(Minv))

k <- ncol(design_points)

Z <- matrix(runif(g_n*k,-1,1),ncol=k)
colnames(Z) <- colnames(design_points)
Z <- as.data.frame(Z)

FZ <- build_X_quadratic(Z)

Gcrit <- max(rowSums((FZ %*% Minv) * FZ))

list(
Dcrit = Dcrit,
Acrit = Acrit,
Gcrit = Gcrit
)

}

############################################################
# SCALED REGULARISED ADG (CORRECT VERSION)
############################################################

compute_ADG_scaled <- function(design_points, lambda0 = 0.01, g_n = 5000){

X <- build_X_quadratic(design_points)

p <- ncol(X)

M <- crossprod(X)

# scaled lambda from paper
lambda_eff <- lambda0 * (sum(diag(M)) / p)

Mlam <- M + lambda_eff * diag(p)

Minv <- solve(Mlam)

Dcrit <- det(Mlam)^(1/p)

Acrit <- sum(diag(Minv))

k <- ncol(design_points)

Z <- matrix(runif(g_n*k,-1,1),ncol=k)
colnames(Z) <- colnames(design_points)
Z <- as.data.frame(Z)

FZ <- build_X_quadratic(Z)

Gcrit <- max(rowSums((FZ %*% Minv) * FZ))

list(
Dcrit = Dcrit,
Acrit = Acrit,
Gcrit = Gcrit
)

}

############################################################
# COMPUTE CRITERIA FOR ALL DESIGNS
############################################################

meta <- read_csv("data_generated/design_metadata.csv")

out_list <- vector("list", nrow(meta))

for(i in seq_len(nrow(meta))){

id <- meta$DesignID[i]

pts <- readRDS(file.path(
"data_generated",
paste0("design_",id,".rds")
))

crit_reg <- compute_ADG_reg(pts,lambda,G_N)

crit_scaled <- compute_ADG_scaled(pts,lambda,G_N)

out_list[[i]] <- tibble(
DesignID = id,

D_reg = crit_reg$Dcrit,
A_reg = crit_reg$Acrit,
G_reg = crit_reg$Gcrit,

D_scaled = crit_scaled$Dcrit,
A_scaled = crit_scaled$Acrit,
G_scaled = crit_scaled$Gcrit
)

}

mycriteria_raw_reg <- bind_rows(out_list)

write_csv(
mycriteria_raw_reg,
"data_generated/mycriteria_raw_reg_scaled.csv"
)

############################################################
# CONVERT TO EFFICIENCIES
############################################################

df <- meta %>%
inner_join(mycriteria_raw_reg,by="DesignID")

mycriteria_eff_reg <- df %>%
group_by(k) %>%
mutate(

Deff_reg = D_reg / max(D_reg,na.rm=TRUE),
Aeff_reg = min(A_reg,na.rm=TRUE) / A_reg,
Geff_reg = min(G_reg,na.rm=TRUE) / G_reg,

Deff_scaled = D_scaled / max(D_scaled,na.rm=TRUE),
Aeff_scaled = min(A_scaled,na.rm=TRUE) / A_scaled,
Geff_scaled = min(G_scaled,na.rm=TRUE) / G_scaled

) %>%
ungroup()

write_csv(
mycriteria_eff_reg,
"data_generated/mycriteria_eff_reg_scaled.csv"
)

############################################################
# MEAN EFFICIENCY BY k AND FAMILY
############################################################

tab_mean <- mycriteria_eff_reg %>%
group_by(k,family) %>%
summarise(

meanD_reg = mean(Deff_reg,na.rm=TRUE),
meanA_reg = mean(Aeff_reg,na.rm=TRUE),
meanG_reg = mean(Geff_reg,na.rm=TRUE),

meanD_scaled = mean(Deff_scaled,na.rm=TRUE),
meanA_scaled = mean(Aeff_scaled,na.rm=TRUE),
meanG_scaled = mean(Geff_scaled,na.rm=TRUE),

.groups="drop"
)

write_csv(
tab_mean,
"Tables/mean_eff_reg_scaled_k3to10.csv"
)

############################################################
# PLOT FUNCTION
############################################################

plot_eff <- function(dat,ycol,ylab,outfile){

p <- ggplot(dat,
aes(x=k,
y=.data[[ycol]],
color=family,
linetype=family,
shape=family,
group=family))+
geom_line(linewidth=1.1)+
geom_point(size=3)+
labs(
x="Number of factors (k)",
y=ylab,
color="CCD family"
)+
theme_minimal(base_size=14)

ggsave(outfile,p,width=8,height=5)

p

}

############################################################
# REGULARISED PLOTS
############################################################

plot_eff(
tab_mean,
"meanG_reg",
"Mean G-efficiency (Regularised)",
"Figures/G_regularised_k3to10.png"
)

plot_eff(
tab_mean,
"meanD_reg",
"Mean D-efficiency (Regularised)",
"Figures/D_regularised_k3to10.png"
)

plot_eff(
tab_mean,
"meanA_reg",
"Mean A-efficiency (Regularised)",
"Figures/A_regularised_k3to10.png"
)

############################################################
# SCALED REGULARISED PLOTS
############################################################

plot_eff(
tab_mean,
"meanG_scaled",
"Mean G-efficiency (Scaled Regularised)",
"Figures/G_scaled_k3to10.png"
)

plot_eff(
tab_mean,
"meanD_scaled",
"Mean D-efficiency (Scaled Regularised)",
"Figures/D_scaled_k3to10.png"
)

plot_eff(
tab_mean,
"meanA_scaled",
"Mean A-efficiency (Scaled Regularised)",
"Figures/A_scaled_k3to10.png"
)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# SCALED REGULARISED SPECTRAL ANALYSIS
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

set.seed(6)

lambda0 <- 0.01

spec_list <- vector("list", nrow(meta))

for(i in seq_len(nrow(meta))){

id <- meta$DesignID[i]

pts <- readRDS(file.path(
"data_generated",
paste0("design_", id, ".rds")
))

X <- build_X_quadratic(pts)

p <- ncol(X)

M <- crossprod(X)

# scaled regularisation parameter
lambda_eff <- lambda0 * (sum(diag(M)) / p)

Mlam <- M + lambda_eff * diag(p)

ev <- eigen(Mlam, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values

ev <- ev[ev > 0]

q <- quantile(ev, probs = c(0.10,0.50,0.90))

spec_list[[i]] <- tibble(

DesignID = id,

eig_q10 = q[1],
eig_q50 = q[2],
eig_q90 = q[3],

min_eig = min(ev),
max_eig = max(ev),

cond_number = max(ev) / min(ev),

log_determinant = sum(log(ev))

)

}

spec_df <- bind_rows(spec_list)

df_spec <- meta %>%
left_join(spec_df, by="DesignID")

############################################################
# Eigenvalue distribution summary
############################################################

eig_summary <- df_spec %>%
group_by(k, family) %>%
summarise(

mean_q10 = mean(eig_q10),
mean_q50 = mean(eig_q50),
mean_q90 = mean(eig_q90),

mean_min_eig = mean(min_eig),
mean_max_eig = mean(max_eig),

.groups="drop"
)

write_csv(
eig_summary,
"Tables/eigenvalue_distribution_scaled.csv"
)

eig_summary

############################################################
# Eigenvalue distribution plot
############################################################

eig_long <- eig_summary %>%
pivot_longer(
cols=c(mean_q10, mean_q50, mean_q90),
names_to="quantile",
values_to="value"
)

p_eig <- ggplot(
eig_long,
aes(x=k, y=value, color=family, group=family)
)+
geom_line(linewidth=1.1)+
geom_point(size=3)+
facet_wrap(~quantile, scales="free_y")+
labs(
x="Number of factors (k)",
y="Eigenvalue",
title="Eigenvalue Distribution (Scaled Regularised)"
)+
theme_minimal(base_size=14)

ggsave(
"Figures/eigenvalue_distribution_scaled.png",
p_eig,
width=10,
height=6
)

p_eig

############################################################
# Condition number growth
############################################################

cond_table <- df_spec %>%
group_by(k, family) %>%
summarise(

mean_condition = mean(cond_number),

.groups="drop"
)

write_csv(
cond_table,
"Tables/condition_number_growth_scaled.csv"
)

cond_table

############################################################
# Condition number growth plot
############################################################

p_cond <- ggplot(
cond_table,
aes(x=k, y=mean_condition, color=family, group=family)
)+
geom_line(linewidth=1.1)+
geom_point(size=3)+
labs(
x="Number of factors (k)",
y="Condition number",
title="Condition Number Growth (Scaled Regularised)"
)+
theme_minimal(base_size=14)

ggsave(
"Figures/condition_number_growth_scaled.png",
p_cond,
width=8,
height=5
)

p_cond

############################################################
# Log Determinant growth
############################################################

logdet_table <- df_spec %>%
group_by(k, family) %>%
summarise(

mean_logdet = mean(log_determinant),

.groups="drop"
)

write_csv(
logdet_table,
"Tables/log_determinant_growth_scaled.csv"
)

logdet_table

############################################################
# Log Determinant growth plot
############################################################

p_logdet <- ggplot(
```

```{r}
############################################################
# CROSS-DIMENSIONAL STABILITY AND SCALING EXPONENTS
# (Scaled Regularised Efficiencies)
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# Load scaled regularised efficiencies
df_eff <- read_csv(
"data_generated/mycriteria_eff_reg_scaled.csv"
)

############################################################
# Mean efficiency by k and family
############################################################

mean_eff <- df_eff %>%
group_by(k, family) %>%
summarise(

meanD = mean(Deff_scaled, na.rm=TRUE),
meanA = mean(Aeff_scaled, na.rm=TRUE),
meanG = mean(Geff_scaled, na.rm=TRUE),

.groups="drop"
)

write_csv(
mean_eff,
"Tables/mean_efficiency_scaled_by_k_family.csv"
)

############################################################
# Convert to long format
############################################################

eff_long <- mean_eff %>%
pivot_longer(
cols = c(meanD, meanA, meanG),
names_to = "criterion",
values_to = "mean_eff"
) %>%
mutate(
criterion = recode(
criterion,
meanD = "D",
meanA = "A",
meanG = "G"
)
)

############################################################
# SCALING EXPONENTS
# log(mean_eff) = beta0 + beta1 log(k)
############################################################

scaling_exponents <- eff_long %>%
filter(mean_eff > 0) %>%
mutate(
log_eff = log(mean_eff),
log_k = log(k)
) %>%
group_by(family, criterion) %>%
do({

fit <- lm(log_eff ~ log_k, data=.)

tibble(
beta0 = coef(fit)[1],
beta1 = coef(fit)[2],
R2 = summary(fit)$r.squared
)

}) %>%
ungroup()

write_csv(
scaling_exponents,
"Tables/scaling_exponents_scaled.csv"
)

scaling_exponents

############################################################
# Scaling exponent plot
############################################################

p_beta <- ggplot(
scaling_exponents,
aes(x=family, y=beta1, fill=family)
)+
geom_col(width=.6)+
facet_wrap(~criterion, scales="free_y")+
labs(
x="CCD Family",
y="Scaling exponent (beta1)",
title="Scaling Exponents of Mean Efficiency (Scaled Regularised)"
)+
theme_minimal(base_size=14)+
theme(legend.position="none")

ggsave(
"Figures/scaling_exponents_scaled.png",
p_beta,
width=10,
height=5
)

p_beta

############################################################
# CROSS-DIMENSIONAL VARIANCE (CDS)
############################################################

cds_variance <- eff_long %>%
group_by(family, criterion) %>%
summarise(

variance = var(mean_eff, na.rm=TRUE),
sd = sd(mean_eff, na.rm=TRUE),
range = max(mean_eff) - min(mean_eff),

.groups="drop"
)

write_csv(
cds_variance,
"Tables/cross_dimensional_variance_scaled.csv"
)

cds_variance

############################################################
# CDS variance plot
############################################################

p_cds <- ggplot(
cds_variance,
aes(x=criterion, y=family, fill=variance)
)+
geom_tile()+
geom_text(aes(label=round(variance,4)))+
scale_fill_gradient(low="lightblue", high="darkblue")+
labs(
x="Efficiency Criterion",
y="CCD Family",
fill="Variance",
title="Cross-Dimensional Variance of Efficiency (Scaled Regularised)"
)+
theme_minimal(base_size=14)

ggsave(
"Figures/cross_dimensional_variance_scaled.png",

p_cds,
width=8,
height=5
)

p_cds
```

```{r}

############################################################
# CDS MAP ACROSS DIMENSIONS (k)
############################################################

cat("\n=== CDS MAP ACROSS k ===\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1: Compute local instability at each k
# CDS(k) = |E(k) - E(k-1)|
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cds_map <- eff_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(family, criterion) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(k) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CDS_k = abs(mean_eff - dplyr::lag(mean_eff))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

readr::write_csv(
  cds_map,
  "Tables/cds_map_per_k_scaled.csv"
)

############################################################
# Step 2: Heatmap (True CDS Map)
############################################################

p_cds_map <- ggplot(
  cds_map %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(CDS_k)),
  aes(x = factor(k), y = family, fill = CDS_k)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(CDS_k, 3)),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~criterion,
    labeller = labeller(
      criterion = c(
        D = "D-efficiency",
        A = "A-efficiency",
        G = "G-efficiency"
      )
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#d1e5f0",
    high = "#08306b",
    name = "CDS(k)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Dimension (k)",
    y = "CCD Family",
    title = "Cross-Dimensional Stability (CDS) Map"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  "Figures/cds_map_heatmap_scaled.png",
  p_cds_map,
  width = 20,
  height = 6
)

p_cds_map

cat("CDS map across k generated successfully.\n")
```
